verses.en: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.sm: Iuta; o Faresa, o Esarona, ma Karame, ma Huro, ma Sovala.

verses.en: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Reaia le atalii o Sovala o Iata; na fanaua e Iata, o Aumi, ma Laata, o aiga ia o sa Soraa.

verses.en: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
verses.sm: O i latou nei mai le tama o Etama; o Isereelu, ma Isema, ma Itapasa; o le igoa foi o lo latou tuafafine o Aseleponi;

verses.en: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.
verses.sm: o Penueli foi le tama o Kitori, ma Esera le tamá o Usa. O atalii ia o Huro, o le ulumatua a Efarata le tama o Peteleema.

verses.en: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.sm: O Asura foi o le tama o Tikoa e toalua ana avá, o Helea, ma Naara.

verses.en: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.sm: Na fanaua mai ia te ia e Naara o Akusama, ma Eferu, ma Timani, ma Akasetari; o fanau ia a Naara.

verses.en: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.sm: O fanau a Helea, o Sereta, ma Soaro, ma Etenano.

verses.en: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Kosa o Anupa, ma Sopepa, ma aiga o Akaraila le atalii o Haruma.

verses.en: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.sm: Ua sili le mamalu o lapese i ona uso; na faaigoa foi lona tina ia te ia o lapesa, ua faapea, Ua ou fanaua o ia ma le tiga.

verses.en: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.sm: Ua valaau atu Iapesa i le Atua o Isaraelu, ua faapea atu, E, fia manuia aʻu ia te oe ma faalauteleina loʻu laueleele, ia ia te au foi lou aao, ma ia e leoleo mai ia te au ai le leaga, ina neʻi tigaina aʻu. Na avatu e le Atua ia te ia le mea na ia faatoga atu ai.

verses.en: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Kalupo le uso o Sua o Mekira, o le tama ia o Esetono.

verses.en: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.sm: Na fanaua e Esetono o Peterafa, ma Pasea, ma Tikina le tama o Irenaasa. O tagata na o Reka.

verses.en: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.sm: O atalii o Kinasa; o Otinielu ma Seraia; o le atalii o Otinielu o Hatata.

verses.en: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.sm: Na fanaua foi e Meonotai o Ofira; na fanaua e Seraia o loapo, o le tupuga ia o tagata o le vanu o tufuga; aua o tufuga i latou.

verses.en: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.sm: O atalii o Kalepo le atalii o Iefune; o Iru, o Ala, ma Naama; o le atalii foi o Ala o Kinasa lava.

verses.en: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.sm: O atalii o Ialeelu o Sifi, ma Sifa, o Tiria, ma Asarcelu.

verses.en: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.sm: O atalii foi o Esera, o letero, ma Mereta, ma Efara, ma lalona. Na fanau mai e ia o Miriama, ma Samai, ma Isapeka le tama o Esetemoa.

verses.en: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.sm: A o lana ava le fafine sa Iutā na ia fanau mai lereto, le tama o Kitori, ma Kaveru le tama o Suka, ma lekutielu le tamá o Sanoa. O fanau ia a Pita le afafine o Farao, na fai aya ai Mereta.

verses.en: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.sm: O tama tane a lana avá o Hotia le tuafafine o Naama, o le tamá o Kaila o le Karami, ma Esetemoa o le Maaka.

verses.en: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
verses.sm: O atalii o Simona; o Amanono, ma Rina, ma Penikanana, ma Tilona. O atalii foi o Isai; o Soketa, ma Penisoketa.

verses.en: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.sm: O atalii o Sila le atalii o Iuta; o Eru le tama o Leka, ma Laata le tama o Maresa, ma tagata o le aiga o e fai ie vavae i le aiga o Asepa.

verses.en: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
verses.sm: O Iokima foi, ma tagata o Koseva, ma Ioasa, ma Sarafa, o e na pule i Moapi, ma Iasuvileema. O mea anamua lava ia.

verses.en: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.sm: O e fai ipu omea ia, ma i latou o e nonofo i fanua ua faatoaina, ma mea ua lotoaina. Ua nonofo ai i latou ma le tupu e fai ai lana galuega.

verses.en: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
verses.sm: O atalii o Simeona, o Nemuelu, ma laminu, o laripa, o Sera, o Saulo.

verses.en: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.sm: O lona atalii o Saluma, o lona atalii o Mepesama, o lona atalii o Mesema.

verses.en: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.sm: O le atalii o Mesema; o Hamuelu lona atalii, o Sakuro lona atalii, o Semi lona atalii.

verses.en: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.sm: O atalii o Semi ua toasefulu ma le toaono, ma ona afafine ua toaono; a ua le faatoatele O fanau a ona uso, ua le faatoateleina o latou aiga uma, faapei o fanau a Iuta.

verses.en: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
verses.sm: Ua mau i latou i Peresepa, ma Molata, ma Asarasuala,

verses.en: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.sm: ma Pala, ma Asema, ma Tolita,

verses.en: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.sm: ma Petueli, ma Horema, ma Sekeleka,

verses.en: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.sm: ma Petemakapa, ma Asara-susa, ma Petepirei, ma i O le faatupu tiga. Saarai. O a latou aai ia e co i le nofoaiga a Tavita.

verses.en: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.sm: O a latou faoa aai o Etama, ma Aino, o Rimoni, ma Tokena, ma Asana, o aai e lima ia;

verses.en: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.sm: o faoa aai uma foi e vagavagaia ia aai e oo i Paala. O latou nuu ia e nonofo ai, ma a latou tusi gafa.

verses.en: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.sm: O Mesopapa foi, ma Iameleka, ma Iosa le atalii o Amasia,

verses.en: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.sm: o Ioelu foi, ma Ieu le atalii o losevia, o le atalii ia o Seraia, o le atalii ia o Asielu,

verses.en: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.sm: o Elioenai foi, ma Iaakopa, ma Iesokaia, ma Asaia, ma Atielu, ma Isemielu, ma Penaia,

verses.en: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.sm: o Sesa foi le atalii o Sepi, o le atalii o Aluna, o le atalii o Ietaia, o le atalii o Semeri, o le atalii o Semaia.

verses.en: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.sm: O i latou ia ua taʻua o latou igoa, o alii sili i latou i o latou aiga; sa faatoateleina lava aiga o latou tamā.

verses.en: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.sm: Ua o atu i latou i le ala e ui ai i Kitori, i le itu i sasae o le vanu, e saili se mea e aai ai o latou lafu mamoe.

verses.en: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.sm: Na maua e i latou le mea ua i ai le vao e tele ma le lelei, ma le fanua lautele, ua mapu ai ma le filemu; auā sa nonofo sa Hamo i lea mea anamua.

verses.en: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.sm: Na o mai i latou ia ua tusia o latou igoa, i ona po o Esekia le tupu o Iuta, ona faaumatia lea o latou fale ie, ma tagata o Meona, e na maua i lea mea, ua latou faaumatia lava i latou ua oo i nei ona po, ua nonofo ai foi i latou ua fai ai mo latou nuu; auā sa i ai mea e aai ai o latou lafu mamoe.

verses.en: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.sm: Na o atu nisi o i latou o le fanauga a Simeona, e toalima selau o tagata, i le mauga o Seira, o i latou na avea a latou “au, o Peletia, ma Nearia, ma Refaia, ma Usialu, o atalii o Isai.

verses.en: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.sm: Ua fasia e i latou o e na totoe o Amaleka o e na sao; ua latou mau ai foi i lea mea e oo i nei ona po.
